maria: heads-up: master CI flagged a golden diff for tests/prompt-render::test_render_v2. Looks like a serialization tweak introduced an extra trailing newline and some quoting changes. CI failure: https://ci.redwood/xyz :frowning:

maria: failing assertion (snippet):
```diff
- "Hello, world!"
+ "Hello, world!\n"
```

ci-bot: rerun attempted (auto-flake): started rerun #1 -> still failed

drew: can someone bisect? this smells like last-night serializer change (PR #4321)

kai: quick triage idea: might be the new JSON escape path toggling newline escapes. Try locally: `pytest tests/prompt-render::test_render_v2 -q -s` and inspect `tests/__snapshots__/render_v2.snap`

sophia: I can run a bisect if you give me a good + bad commit

maria: good: 1790000000 (passes), bad: 1791234567 (current master). Bisect steps:
```bash
git bisect start
git bisect bad 1791234567
git bisect good 1790000000
# run the test, then mark good/bad accordingly
pytest tests/prompt-render::test_render_v2 -q
```

sophia: starting bisect now, will report back in ~15m :coffee:

sophia: update: bisect found culprit -> commit 1790564321 "serialize: normalize trailing newlines"

maria: ok that matches. Question: was that normalization intentional for API compatibility? If yes, we should update golden snapshots; if not, revert or adjust serializer behavior.

drew: pinging @ops to see if any downstream users depend on the old trailing-newline behavior

kai: interim test-side fix I can push: make snapshot comparisons tolerant to an optional trailing newline (trim before compare). If that gets CI green quickly we can follow up with a proper serializer decision.

maria: sounds good. @ci-bot please enqueue a rerun with branch `tests/fix/snapline-trim` once PR is open

ci-bot: manual rerun queued by maria, run id 987654

ci-bot: rerun finished -> all tests green :tada:

maria: merging the test patch now. Follow-up: open an issue to discuss serializer newline policy + changelog note. Thanks all for the quick turnaround!

kai: noted, will open issue and add to next sprint.

sophia: marking bisect done and closing thread."
